# Nell Harcourt

## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slim young woman with gray eyes and auburn hair that she wears in short ringlets or plaits bound by a black velvet ribbon. Originally possessing fiery red hair, freckles, and a thin frame, her appearance softens as she matures into adulthood, though she retains her expressive features and striking gray eyes. She takes care in her dress, favoring stylish outfits, green muslin, and white organdy.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c31 P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000), [v1 c34 P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c22 P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 c27 P6](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0006), [v3 c27 P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 c33 P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)_

## Personality

Nell is an imaginative, loquacious, and passionate person who views the world with romantic wonder and optimism. She possesses an intense sensitivity to nature, beauty, and emotional connections, often renaming places and inventing dramatic narratives. Though prone to impulsive decisions, quick flashes of temper, and deep fits of despair over minor setbacks, she is deeply loyal, generous, and devoted to those she loves. As she grows into adulthood, she becomes more reflective and thoughtful while retaining her core warmth, creativity, and imaginative spirit.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c2 P56](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0056), [v1 c4 P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 c5 P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c31 P20](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0020), [v1 c31 P21](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0021), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c20 P4](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0004), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)_

## History

Arriving at Alder River station expecting to find a home, eleven-year-old orphan Nell Harcourt is met by Obed Abernethy, who brought her to Grey Shutters despite having requested a boy. Although Thirza Abernethy initially intends to send her back, Nell's emotional vulnerability and imaginative nature convince the siblings to keep her. She quickly adapts to Grey Shutters, making deep friendships with Isolde Pembroke and learning domestic skills under Thirza's firm guidance. When she enters Brierley School, an initial clash with classmate Hugh Carrow leads to a rivalry, though she eventually earns academic success. Over the years, Nell matures into an earnest student, leading the Brierley Village Improvement Society, founding a story-writing club, and successfully taking the Entrance Examination at the head of her class.

After graduating from Regent's Academy, Nell works as a teacher at Brierley School to help support Thirza and care for two orphaned twins, Robin and Lucy Farrow. She implements non-violent discipline in her classroom and earns the respect of her pupils. When Obed Abernethy suddenly dies following the collapse of the Abbey Bank, Nell stays at Grey Shutters to comfort Thirza. Later, when a inheritance from Miss Lavinia Pembroke provides financial independence, Nell resumes her higher education at Wexcombe College alongside her friends. During her senior year at Wexcombe, she wins the Thorburn Scholarship in English and earns her Bachelor of Arts degree with High Honors. Following graduation, she returns to Brierley and reconciles her long-standing romantic feelings with Hugh Carrow, accepting his proposal of marriage as they look forward to their shared future.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c3 P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v2 c1 P2](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0002), [v2 c1 P51](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0051), [v2 c4 P15](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0015), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v3 c18 P28](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0028), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), [v3 c36 P12](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0012), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023), [v3 c41 P25](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0025), [v3 c41 P38](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0038)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to Edmund and Bertha Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned at three months old when both parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised initially by Mrs. Thomas until age eight  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived up-river with Mrs. Rudge for two years caring for three sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Spent four months in Marden orphan asylum before being sent to P.E.I.  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by Thirza and Obed Abernethy of Grey Shutters at age eleven  <sub>[v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

## Quotes

> My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.  <sub>[v1 c5 P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)</sub>

> I’m not returning, Thirza. I’ll study my lessons at home and I’ll be as well-behaved as I can manage and keep quiet continuously if it’s at all feasible. But I will not return to school, I promise you.  <sub>[v1 c15 P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081)</sub>

> Going back to a place I know is truly home feels wonderful. Grey Shutters has my love already, even though I have never cared for anywhere else before. Not a single place ever felt like home to me. Oh, Thirza, my happiness is so great. I could offer up a prayer this very minute without struggling in the slightest.  <sub>[v1 c10 P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)</sub>

> Fundamentally, I will perpetually remain your little Nell, loving you, Obed, and beloved Grey Shutters increasingly with each passing day.  <sub>[v3 c34 P6](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0006)</sub>

> With God residing in his heaven, everything on earth is as it should be.  <sub>[v1 c38 P63](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0063)</sub>
